description: Issue #839: a Heritage short alias is a built-in name at run time, exactly as illegal to declare as the canonical it spells. The runtime resolves the alias to its canonical and re-runs the same lookup rather than consulting a table of its own (`spec/conformance.md:150`, Heritage is "alternate spellings only"), so `define fd` is `ol-reserved-word` because `define forward` is. The empty event stream is what makes this discriminating: `999` would mean the learner's procedure ran, and a `move` event would mean the turtle did.

diagnostics.message: fd is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
